name: fm-reese
about: A heavy bass: a reese (two saws 28 cents apart, one each side, grinding against each other) over an FM growl (a sine bent by another that feeds back on itself, so it snarls rather than sings), mono and gliding, driven hard under a resonant low-pass that every note kicks open. Bright opens the filter three octaves, Drive takes it from crunchy to filthy, and Sweep opens it two octaves more across a build. Put a pure sub under it and cut its lows
